Carlos Saura's film, starring Carmen Maura in a career-defining performance, is a meditation on art, complicity, and human decency under extremity.

Title: Bullet in the Head

What follows is a prolonged ordeal of capture, torture, and moral disintegration in the jungle that destroys the friendship and transforms each man irrevocably: one into a killer, one into a wraith, one into a traitor. John Woo's most personal and unrelenting film draws explicitly on the trauma of the Cultural Revolution and on the director's own memories of Hong Kong street violence to make a tragic register almost entirely absent from his other work.

Title: The Company of Strangers

An extraordinarily gentle film that treats its subjects with the full seriousness they deserve.
